refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to fetch an installed in-language function

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Fetch the function identified by function_name from object. This function exists mainly for unit testing.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoEngineFetchFunction returns a pointer to the function, or NULLif no matching function is installed or there is a memory error. The object pointed to is still owned by object and must not be passed to SilikoFunctionDestroy.
